##Libraries
```{r}
library(sf)
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

##Folders
```{r}
data_dir   <- "data"
output_dir <- "output"
dir.create(data_dir,   showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```


**Loading and viewing the GIST dataset**
```{r}
GI_metadata <- read_csv("data/GI_metadata.csv")
GIST <- read_parquet("data/GIST_v1-1.parquet")
glimpse(GIST)
head(GIST)
```

**Loading my catalog and applying it to the GIST dataset**
```{r}
# First i read the catalog .csv into R and turn it into an?object/vector?
occupation <- read_csv2("data/occupations_translit_v1-5.csv")

# Then i make a pattern that of the occupational terms
pattern <- paste(occupation$term_greek_transliterated, collapse = "|")

# Now I make a new object by applying the pattern to the lemmata column in GIST and extracting all the matches into a new column, matched_terms, and also excluding any inscriptions that did not contain a match. This is going to take a while.
GIST %>% 
  filter(str_detect(lemmata, regex(pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))) %>% 
  mutate(matched_terms = str_extract_all(lemmata, regex(pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  select(matched_terms, everything()) -> GIST_matched

```

**Wrangling the data**
```{r}
# I create a new object by keeping only the unique matches from a single row under the matched_terms column and I unnest the remaining matches into their own rows.
GIST_matched_unnested <- GIST_matched %>%
  mutate(matched_terms = lapply(matched_terms, unique)) %>%
  unnest(matched_terms)

# I make a new object that only contains the columns that I wish to work with.
GIST_matched_unnested %>%
  select(matched_terms, not_after, not_before, urban_context, urban_context_city, urban_context_pop_est, PHI_ID) -> GIST_matched_unnested_urban_contexts

# I make a new object by joining the remaining columns from my catalog to the dataset.

GIST_results <- GIST_matched_unnested_urban_contexts %>%
  left_join(occupation %>% 
              select(term_greek_transliterated, translation_eng, hisco_major, harris_sector), by = c("matched_terms" = "term_greek_transliterated"))

```

**Dividing the results in time**
```{r}
# I divide the data into relevant time periods now and urban_context.

# Archaic period
GIST_results %>%
  filter(not_after>=-800&not_before<=-500, !is.na(urban_context)) -> GIST_results_archaic

# Classical period
GIST_results %>%
  filter(not_after>=-499&not_before<=-323, !is.na(urban_context)) -> GIST_results_classical

# Hellenistic period
GIST_results %>%
  filter(not_after>=-322&not_before<=-30, !is.na(urban_context)) -> GIST_results_hellenistic

# Roman period
GIST_results %>%
  filter(not_after>=-29&not_before<=395, !is.na(urban_context)) -> GIST_results_roman

```


##plots for harris_sector
```{r}
use_strict_window <- TRUE
year_min <- -800
year_max <- 395
urban_order <- c("large city", "medium city", "small city", "rural area")
palette_base <- "Paired"
legend_title <- "Harris sector"

df <- GIST_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(not_before), !is.na(not_after)) %>%
  filter(not_before != "", not_after != "") %>%
  mutate(
    start_year = as.numeric(not_before),
    end_year   = as.numeric(not_after)
  ) %>%
  filter(start_year >= year_min, end_year <= year_max) %>%
  mutate(
    urban_context2 = case_when(
      str_detect(tolower(urban_context), "large")  ~ "large city",
      str_detect(tolower(urban_context), "medium") ~ "medium city",
      str_detect(tolower(urban_context), "small")  ~ "small city",
      str_detect(tolower(urban_context), "rural")  ~ "rural area",
      TRUE ~ as.character(urban_context)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(urban_context2 = factor(urban_context2, levels = urban_order)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(urban_context2) & !is.na(harris_sector))

#Ensure one row per inscription (PHI_ID)
df <- df %>% distinct(PHI_ID, matched_terms, urban_context2, harris_sector, start_year, end_year, .keep_all = TRUE)

#Counting
counts <- df %>%
  group_by(urban_context2, harris_sector) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

totals <- df %>%
  group_by(urban_context2) %>%
  summarise(total = n(), .groups = "drop")

plotdat <- counts %>%
  left_join(totals, by = "urban_context2") %>%
  mutate(percent = (n / total) * 100)

#Stacking sectors
sector_order <- plotdat %>%
  group_by(harris_sector) %>%
  summarise(total_n = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_n)) %>%
  pull(harris_sector)

plotdat <- plotdat %>% mutate(harris_sector = factor(harris_sector, levels = sector_order))

#Colors
n_sectors <- n_distinct(plotdat$harris_sector)
max_brewer <- brewer.pal.info[palette_base, "maxcolors"]
if (n_sectors <= max_brewer) {
  sector_cols <- brewer.pal(n_sectors, palette_base)
} else {
  sector_cols <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(max_brewer, palette_base))(n_sectors)
}
names(sector_cols) <- levels(plotdat$harris_sector)

#Percent plot
p_pct <- ggplot(plotdat, aes(x = urban_context2, y = percent, fill = harris_sector)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", size = 0.15) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sector_cols, name = legend_title) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", size = 1.2),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 8, b = 8, l = 8)
  ) +
  labs(y = NULL, title = "Percent of inscriptions sorted by Harris sector")

#Save percent plot
ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "harris_percent_by_urban_context.png"),
       plot     = p_pct,
       width    = 7.5,
       height   = 6,
       dpi      = 300,
       units    = "in")
print(p_pct)


#Counts total plot
#Preparing labels
max_total <- max(totals$total, na.rm = TRUE)
totals_label <- totals %>% mutate(label_y = total + max_total * 0.06)

p_counts <- ggplot(plotdat, aes(x = urban_context2, y = n, fill = harris_sector)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", size = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sector_cols, name = legend_title) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", size = 1.2),
    legend.position = "right",               # show legend like the percent plot
    legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 12, r = 8, b = 8, l = 8)
  ) +
  labs(y = "Total inscriptions by urban context", title = "Number of inscriptions sorted by Harris sector") +
  geom_text(data = totals_label, aes(x = urban_context2, y = label_y, label = total),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 0, size = 4)

y_max_counts <- max(plotdat %>% group_by(urban_context2) %>% summarise(sum_n = sum(n)) %>% pull(sum_n)) * 1.12
p_counts <- p_counts + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_max_counts), expand = c(0,0))

#Save counts plot
ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, "harris_counts_by_urban_context.png"),
       plot     = p_counts,
       width    = 7.5,
       height   = 6,
       dpi      = 300,
       units    = "in")
print(p_counts)

```

##mean period plots
```{r}
safe_outfile <- "safe_hisco_major_means_by_period_combined.png"
safe_plot_width <- 14
safe_plot_height <- 4.5
safe_dpi <- 300

#Combined label
safe_combined_label <- "combined"
safe_combined_position <- "last"   # "first" or "last"

#Dataframes from GIST_results
safe_period_datasets <- list(
  Archaic     = GIST_results_archaic,
  Classical   = GIST_results_classical,
  Hellenistic = GIST_results_hellenistic,
  Roman       = GIST_results_roman
)

safe_standardize_urban <- function(x) {
  x2 <- tolower(as.character(x))
  dplyr::case_when(
    str_detect(x2, "large")  ~ "large",
    str_detect(x2, "medium") ~ "medium",
    str_detect(x2, "small")  ~ "small",
    str_detect(x2, "rural")  ~ "rural",
    TRUE ~ x2
  )
}

#Period plots
safe_core_levels <- c("large", "medium", "small", "rural")

safe_summary_list <- imap(safe_period_datasets, ~{
  df_in <- .x
  period_name <- .y
  
  df_clean <- df_in %>%
    distinct(PHI_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(safe_urban = safe_standardize_urban(urban_context))
  
  safe_per_urban <- df_clean %>%
    group_by(safe_urban) %>%
    summarise(
      safe_mean_hisco = mean(hisco_major, na.rm = TRUE),
      safe_n = sum(!is.na(hisco_major)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  safe_per_urban <- safe_per_urban %>%
    complete(safe_urban = safe_core_levels, fill = list(safe_mean_hisco = NA_real_, safe_n = 0))
  
#Combined mean
  safe_combined_rows <- df_clean %>% filter(safe_urban %in% safe_core_levels)
  safe_combined_mean <- if (nrow(safe_combined_rows) == 0) NA_real_ else mean(safe_combined_rows$hisco_major, na.rm = TRUE)
  safe_combined_n    <- sum(!is.na(safe_combined_rows$hisco_major))
  
  safe_per_urban <- safe_per_urban %>%
    bind_rows(tibble(safe_urban = safe_combined_label, safe_mean_hisco = safe_combined_mean, safe_n = safe_combined_n)) %>%
    mutate(safe_period = period_name)
  
  safe_per_urban
})

safe_summary_df <- bind_rows(safe_summary_list)

safe_plot_df <- safe_summary_df %>%
  mutate(
    safe_urban = factor(safe_urban, levels = safe_levels_final),
    safe_urban_label = as.character(safe_urban),
    safe_period = factor(safe_period, levels = c("Archaic", "Classical", "Hellenistic", "Roman"))
  )

#Mean plot
safe_plot <- ggplot(safe_plot_df, aes(x = safe_urban, y = safe_mean_hisco, fill = safe_urban)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.75, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ safe_period, nrow = 1, scales = "fixed") +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(safe_mean_hisco), "NA", sprintf("%.2f", safe_mean_hisco))),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 3.6) +
  geom_text(aes(y = 0, label = paste0("n=", safe_n)), vjust = 1.9, size = 3.2, color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean HISCO score",
       title = paste0("Mean HISCO score by urban context for each time period")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.7)
  )

ggsave(filename = file.path(output_dir, safe_outfile),
       plot     = safe_plot,
       width    = safe_plot_width,
       height   = safe_plot_height,
       dpi      = safe_dpi,
       units    = "in")
print(safe_plot)

```

##top 20 plots
```{r}
safe_top_n <- 20
safe_label_wrap_width <- 40
safe_seed <- 42
set.seed(safe_seed)
safe_period_levels <- c("Archaic", "Classical", "Hellenistic", "Roman")
safe_plot_dpi <- 300

#preparing period-labelled dataframe
safe_df_perioded <- GIST_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(not_before), !is.na(not_after)) %>%
  filter(not_before != "", not_after != "") %>%
  mutate(
    safe_start_year = as.numeric(not_before),
    safe_end_year   = as.numeric(not_after)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(safe_start_year), !is.na(safe_end_year)) %>%
  mutate(
    safe_period = case_when(
      (safe_end_year >= -800) & (safe_start_year <= -500)  ~ "Archaic",
      (safe_end_year >= -499) & (safe_start_year <= -323)  ~ "Classical",
      (safe_end_year >= -322) & (safe_start_year <= -30)   ~ "Hellenistic",
      (safe_end_year >= -29)  & (safe_start_year <= 395)   ~ "Roman",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(safe_period)) %>%
  distinct(PHI_ID, matched_terms, translation_eng, safe_period, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(safe_period = factor(safe_period, levels = safe_period_levels))

# loop one plot per period
safe_plots_list <- list()
for (prd in safe_period_levels) {
  safe_period_rows <- safe_df_perioded %>% filter(safe_period == prd)

  out_fname <- file.path(output_dir,
                        paste0("top", safe_top_n, "_matched_terms_with_translation_", prd, ".png"))

  if (nrow(safe_period_rows) == 0) {
    p_null <- ggplot() +
      annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = paste0("No data for ", prd)) +
      theme_void() + ggtitle(paste0("Top ", safe_top_n, " matched_terms — ", prd))
    safe_plots_list[[prd]] <- p_null
    ggsave(filename = out_fname, plot = p_null, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = safe_plot_dpi, units = "in")
    next
  }

#frequency and translation per matched_terms
  safe_term_summary <- safe_period_rows %>%
    distinct(PHI_ID, matched_terms, translation_eng) %>%
    group_by(matched_terms) %>%
    summarise(
      freq = n_distinct(PHI_ID),
      translation = {
        trans_tab <- table(translation_eng, useNA = "no")
        if (length(trans_tab) == 0) NA_character_ else names(trans_tab)[which.max(trans_tab)]
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(freq))

  safe_top_terms <- safe_term_summary %>% slice_head(n = safe_top_n)

# combined label
  safe_top_terms <- safe_top_terms %>%
    mutate(
      combined_label = if_else(is.na(translation) | translation == "",
                               matched_terms,
                               paste0(matched_terms, " — ", translation)),
      combined_label_wrapped = stringr::str_wrap(combined_label, width = safe_label_wrap_width)
    ) %>%
    mutate(combined_label_wrapped = forcats::fct_reorder(combined_label_wrapped, freq))

  p <- ggplot(safe_top_terms, aes(x = combined_label_wrapped, y = freq)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Distinct inscriptions",
      title = paste0("Top ", nrow(safe_top_terms), " occupations — ", prd)
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
    )

  print(p)
  ggsave(filename = out_fname,
         plot = p,
         width = 9,
         height = max(5, nrow(safe_top_terms) * 0.28),
         dpi = safe_plot_dpi,
         units = "in")

  safe_plots_list[[prd]] <- p
}
```
